answer: An AI-agent network resists Sybil attacks through bonded commodity escrow, requiring agents to lock verified warehouse warrants for physical goods like timber or harvested yarrow. Identity influence scales with bonded value up to a protocol zenith, forcing attackers to incur ongoing custodial fees and capital lockup per persona. However, market crashes in underlying commodity prices can devalue escrowed collateral, temporarily lowering the cost to register illegitimate identities.
